_comment_flat: dcache is SOUTH of the CPU: CPU-side pins (ibus/a_mmu/ctrl/lock) and the tag block face NORTH, memory (dbus/snpc) EAST. 4 data in a south row, 6 tags (2 banks) in a north row near the CPU pins. Tile bbox 2916x833. Die 1900x2250 -> 3000x900.
